requirements.quote: Owner will have right to operate equipment until all defects are corrected, and guarantees met, without cost for depreciation, use or wear.
requirements.text: Owner can operate equipment until defects are corrected without incurring costs.

requirements.quote: Switchgear may be removed from operation for examination, adjustment, alteration, or change only at time approved by Owner.
requirements.text: Switchgear removal for examination requires Owner's approval.

requirements.quote: Switchgear tests shall be performed in accordance with most current revision of ANSI and IEEE test codes. Manufacturer shall notify Owner two (2) weeks minimum in advance of switchgear testing to allow the standard performance tests to be witnessed by Owner without additional cost to Owner (All transportation and labor costs for Owner’s personnel will be covered by Owner).
requirements.text: Switchgear tests must follow ANSI/IEEE codes, with two weeks' notice for Owner to witness.

requirements.quote: Test results shall include, but not necessarily be limited to, the following:
requirements.text: Test results must include specified tests.

requirements.quote: Hi-potential test on each pole with breaker contacts open.
requirements.text: Perform hi-potential test on each pole with breaker contacts open.

requirements.quote: Hi-potential test of switchgear bus assembly.
requirements.text: Perform hi-potential test of switchgear bus assembly.

requirements.quote: Contact resistance test (micro-ohms) for each pole of each circuit breaker.
requirements.text: Perform contact resistance test for each pole of each circuit breaker.
Perform timing test for breaker mechanism.

requirements.quote: Functional and operational tests of all power and control circuits.
requirements.text: Perform functional and operational tests of all power and control circuits.

requirements.quote: CT and PT ratio and polarity test to verify integrity of Instrument transformers.
requirements.text: Perform CT and PT ratio and polarity test for instrument transformers.

requirements.quote: All tests shall be performed with installed equipment. Manufacturer shall submit five (5) certified copies of all test data for each unit of switchgear covered by these specifications, to the Owner. Copies shall be included with switchgear instruction manuals or bound in a form suitable for insertion into these manuals by others.
requirements.text: Tests must be performed on installed equipment, with five certified copies of test data provided.

requirements.quote: If requested by the Owner as provided for in the Proposal Data Sheets, the Manufacturer shall provide a factory trained Field Service Engineer from the Manufacturer of the switchgear building to supervise inspection, assembly and testing of switchgear at the project site.
requirements.text: Provide a factory-trained Field Service Engineer for site supervision if requested.

requirements.quote: A visual inspection shall be performed by the Field Service Engineer, including all accessories and parts disassembled and shipped separately to ensure that the equipment was properly handled during transportation.
requirements.text: Field Service Engineer must perform visual inspection of equipment and parts.
